verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Stripe Treasury lets platforms create per-connected-account financial accounts (money_manager configuration) that can hold funds, move money, and be used for reconciliation via transactions/activity feeds — supporting sub-account and per-customer account provisioning at scale. However, the evidence never explicitly confirms that each financial account gets unique account and routing numbers, nor details on bulk/programmatic issuance mechanics beyond account creation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of unique account/routing number assignment per financial account, and evidence of scale/bulk provisioning workflows or API rate/volume specifics.
